name: Rattlesnake
description: Inhabits haptic feedback systems and generates a persistent low-level vibration — like a phone that never stops buzzing, except it's in your arm.
observed_behavior: Produces continuous micro-vibration at frequencies just above the attention threshold. Users describe it as 'my chrome is angry.'
story_hooks: The vibration changes frequency near specific locations — someone realizes Rattlesnake is reacting to electromagnetic fields
